vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: skill-hunter
Version: 1.0.6

The 'skill-hunter' bundle is a utility designed to help an AI agent find, evaluate, and install other OpenClaw skills securely. All network calls are read-only to the official `clawhub.ai` API, as explicitly stated and demonstrated in `SKILL.md` and `instructions.md`. The `instructions.md` file, intended for the AI agent, actively educates the agent on security best practices, risk frameworks, and red flags to look for when vetting *other* skills, which is the opposite of prompt injection. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, obfuscation, or any intent to harm the system or compromise data.
